Client Pulse
Setup Guide
Step 1 of 8
Advisor Onboarding

Set up Client Pulse
on your own sheet

Eight short steps to copy the code into your own Google Sheet, approve access, deploy it, connect Client Pulse, and start sending automated dues reminders and birthday greetings — from your own Gmail, on your own data.

⏱  About 8 minutes
📄  1 file to paste
🔒  Runs on your account only
Begin setup
  1. 1Create your sheet
  2. 2Open Apps Script
  3. 3Paste the code
  4. 4Setup sheet & authorize
  5. 5Deploy
  6. 6Open Client Pulse
  7. 7Upload your data
  8. 8Set send time
01

Create your Google Sheet

This sheet will hold your client lists and become your own private copy of Client Pulse — nothing here is shared with other advisors.

  1. Go to drive.google.com
  2. Click New → Google Sheets
  3. Rename it: Client Pulse — [Your Name]
02

Open Apps Script

  1. In your new sheet, click Extensions in the top menu
  2. Click Apps Script
  3. A new tab opens with a code editor — this is where the next two steps happen
03

Paste the main code

The file Code.gs is already open with some starter text. Clear it out, then paste the code below in its place.

  1. Click inside Code.gs, select everything (Ctrl+A), and delete it
  2. Copy the full code below and paste it in
  3. Save with Ctrl+S
Code.gs 959 lines

53function uploadBrandImage(target, base64, mimeType){
54 if (target !== 'header' && target !== 'footer'){
55 throw new Error('Invalid image target: ' + target);
56 }
57 const configKey = target === 'header' ? 'headerImageFileId' : 'footerImageFileId';
58 const propKey = 'CFG_' + configKey;
59 const props = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
60 
61 const oldFileId = props.getProperty(propKey);
62 if (oldFileId){
63 try{ DriveApp.getFileById(oldFileId).setTrashed(true); }catch(e){ /* already gone */ }
64 }
65 
66 const bytes = Utilities.base64Decode(base64);
67 const blob = Utilities.newBlob(bytes, mimeType || 'image/png', target + '.png');
68 const file = DriveApp.createFile(blob);
69 
70 props.setProperty(propKey, file.getId());
71 return file.getId();
72}

114function setupSheet(){
115 const ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
116 let sheet = ss.getSheetByName(SHEET_NAME);
117 if (!sheet){
118 sheet = ss.insertSheet(SHEET_NAME);
119 }
120 if (sheet.getLastRow() === 0){
121 sheet.appendRow(HEADERS);
122 sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
123 } else if (sheet.getLastRow() > 0){
124 const headers = sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, sheet.getLastColumn()).getValues()[0];
125 if (!headers.includes('Send Dues?')){
126 const lastCol = HEADERS.length;
127 sheet.getRange(1, lastCol).setValue('Send Dues?');
128 for (let i = 2; i <= sheet.getLastRow(); i++){
129 sheet.getRange(i, lastCol).setValue(true);
130 }
131 }
132 }
133 const policyColIndex = HEADERS.indexOf('Policy Number') + 1;
134 sheet.getRange(1, policyColIndex, sheet.getMaxRows(), 1).setNumberFormat('@');
135}
136

181function setSendHour(hour){
182 hour = Number(hour);
183 if (!(hour >= 6 && hour <= 16)){
184 throw new Error('Send hour must be between 6 (6-7AM) and 16 (4-5PM).');
185 }
186 PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().setProperty('SEND_HOUR', String(hour));
187 createDailyTrigger(hour);
188 createBirthdayDailyTrigger(hour);
189 return { hour: hour };
190}
191 
192function createDailyTrigger(hour){
193 hour = hour !== undefined ? hour : getSendHour().hour;
194 ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(t => {
195 if (t.getHandlerFunction() === 'sendDailyReminders') ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(t);
196 });
197 ScriptApp.newTrigger('sendDailyReminders')
198 .timeBased()
199 .everyDays(1)
200 .atHour(hour)
201 .create();
202}
203 
204function createBirthdayDailyTrigger(hour){
205 hour = hour !== undefined ? hour : getSendHour().hour;
206 ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().forEach(t => {
207 if (t.getHandlerFunction() === 'sendDailyBirthdayGreetings') ScriptApp.deleteTrigger(t);
208 });
209 ScriptApp.newTrigger('sendDailyBirthdayGreetings')
210 .timeBased()
211 .everyDays(1)
212 .atHour(hour)
213 .create();
214}

220// Fetch all clients from Dues Tracker with their current Send Dues? preference
221function getDuesClientList(){
222 setupSheet();
223 const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getSheetByName(SHEET_NAME);
224 if (!sheet) return [];
225
226 const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
227 const headers = data[0];
228 const col = name => headers.indexOf(name);
229
230 const result = [];
231 for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++){
232 const row = data[i];
233 const policyNum = row[col('Policy Number')];
234 const clientName = row[col('Client Name')];
235 const email = row[col('Email')];
236 const product = row[col('Product')];
237 const premiumMode = row[col('Premium Mode')];
238 let premiumAmount = row[col('Premium Amount')];
239 const dueDate = row[col('Due Date')];
240 const policyStatus = row[col('Policy Status')];
241 const sendDues = row[col('Send Dues?')];
242
243 if (!policyNum) continue; // skip empty rows
244
245 // Parse premium amount - handle currency symbols, spaces, commas
246 let parsedAmount = 0;
247 if (premiumAmount) {
248 if (typeof premiumAmount === 'number') {
249 parsedAmount = premiumAmount;
250 } else {
251 // Remove common currency symbols and spaces, parse as number
252 const cleaned = String(premiumAmount).replace(/[^\d.-]/g, '').trim();
253 parsedAmount = parseFloat(cleaned) || 0;
254 }
255 }
256
257 result.push({
258 policyNumber: policyNum,
259 clientName: clientName,
260 email: email,
261 product: product,
262 premiumMode: premiumMode,
263 premiumAmount: parsedAmount,
264 dueDate: dueDate instanceof Date ? Utilities.formatDate(dueDate, Session.getScriptTimeZone(), 'yyyy-MM-dd') : '',
265 policyStatus: policyStatus,
266 sendDues: sendDues === true || sendDues === 'TRUE' || sendDues === 1 || sendDues === '1'
267 });
268 }
269 return result;
270}
271

304}

306// Save preference toggle for a specific policy (Dues)
307function setDuesPreference(policyNumber, enabled){
308 setupSheet();
309 const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getSheetByName(SHEET_NAME);
310 const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
311 const headers = data[0];
312 const policyCol = headers.indexOf('Policy Number');
313 const sendCol = headers.indexOf('Send Dues?');
314
315 for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++){
316 if (String(data[i][policyCol]) === String(policyNumber)){
317 sheet.getRange(i + 1, sendCol + 1).setValue(enabled);
318 return { success: true };
319 }
320 }
321 return { success: false, error: 'Policy not found' };
322}
323 
324// Save preference toggle for a specific client (Birthday)

326 setupBirthdaySheet();
327 const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getSheetByName(BIRTHDAY_SHEET_NAME);
328 const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();

331 const sendCol = headers.indexOf('Send Birthday?');
332
333 for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++){
334 if (String(data[i][emailCol]).toLowerCase() === String(email).toLowerCase()){
335 sheet.getRange(i + 1, sendCol + 1).setValue(enabled);
336 return { success: true };
337 }
338 }
339 return { success: false, error: 'Email not found' };
340}

489/* ============================================================
490 PUSH PARSED ROWS FROM THE PARSER TOOL

492function pushDuesRows(rows){
493 setupSheet();
494 const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getSheetByName(SHEET_NAME);
495 
496 const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
497 const policyCol = HEADERS.indexOf('Policy Number');
498 const lastReminderCol = HEADERS.indexOf('Last Reminder Sent');
499 
500 const existingRowByPolicy = {};
501 for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++){
502 existingRowByPolicy[String(data[i][policyCol])] = i;
503 }
504 
505 let added = 0, updated = 0;
506 const newRows = [];
507 
508 rows.forEach(r => {
509 const dueDateValue = r.dueDate ? new Date(r.dueDate) : '';
510 const rowValues = [
511 r.policyNumber, r.clientName, r.email, r.product,
512 r.premiumMode, r.premiumAmount, dueDateValue, r.policyStatus, '', true // empty Last Reminder Sent, default Send Dues? to true
513 ];
514 const idx = existingRowByPolicy[String(r.policyNumber)];
515 if (idx !== undefined){
516 const lastReminderSent = data[idx][lastReminderCol];
517 const sendDues = data[idx][HEADERS.indexOf('Send Dues?')];
518 data[idx] = rowValues;
519 data[idx][lastReminderCol] = lastReminderSent;
520 data[idx][HEADERS.indexOf('Send Dues?')] = sendDues;
521 updated++;
522 } else {
523 newRows.push(rowValues);
524 added++;
525 }
526 });
527 
528 const fullData = data.concat(newRows);
529 sheet.getRange(1, 1, fullData.length, HEADERS.length).setValues(fullData);
530 
531 return { added: added, updated: updated, total: rows.length };
532}
533

541

552 const rowValues = [
553 r.fullName, r.email, r.contactNumber, r.location, dobValue, '', true // empty Last Greeting Sent, default Send Birthday? to true

566 }

572 return { added: added, updated: updated, total: rows.length };

600function countDueOnOffset(offsetDays){
601 const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getSheetByName(SHEET_NAME);
602 if (!sheet) return 0;
603 const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
604 const headers = data[0];
605 const col = name => headers.indexOf(name);
606 const tz = Session.getScriptTimeZone();
607 const targetDate = new Date();
608 targetDate.setDate(targetDate.getDate() + offsetDays);
609 const targetStr = Utilities.formatDate(targetDate, tz, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
610 
611 let count = 0;
612 for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++){
613 const dueDate = data[i][col('Due Date')];
614 if (!(dueDate instanceof Date)) continue;
615 if (Utilities.formatDate(dueDate, tz, 'yyyy-MM-dd') === targetStr) count++;
616 }
617 return count;
618}

629function sendDailyReminders(){
630 if (!getAutoSendStatus().enabled) return;
631 const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getSheetByName(SHEET_NAME);
632 if (!sheet) return;
633 const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
634 const headers = data[0];
635 const col = name => headers.indexOf(name);
636 
637 const tz = Session.getScriptTimeZone();
638 const todayStr = Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), tz, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
639 
640 for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++){
641 const row = data[i];
642 const sendDues = row[col('Send Dues?')];
643
644 // SKIP if Send Dues? is FALSE
645 if (sendDues === false || sendDues === 'FALSE' || sendDues === 0 || sendDues === '0') continue;
646
647 const dueDate = row[col('Due Date')];
648 if (!(dueDate instanceof Date)) continue;
649 
650 const dueDateStr = Utilities.formatDate(dueDate, tz, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
651 const lastSent = row[col('Last Reminder Sent')];
652 const lastSentStr = lastSent ? String(lastSent) : '';
653 
654 if (dueDateStr === todayStr && lastSentStr !== todayStr){
655 let sent = false;
656 try{
657 sent = sendReminderEmail(row, col);
658 }catch(err){
659 bumpDailyStat('STAT_FAILED');
660 continue;
661 }
662 if (sent){
663 bumpDailyStat('STAT_SENT');
664 sheet.getRange(i + 1, col('Last Reminder Sent') + 1).setValue(todayStr);
665 advanceDueDate(sheet, i + 1, col, dueDate, row[col('Premium Mode')]);
666 }
667 }
668 }
669}

705function formatClientName(rawName){
706 const name = String(rawName || '').trim();
707 if (!name) return '';
708 const commaIdx = name.indexOf(',');
709 if (commaIdx === -1) return name;
710 const lastName = name.slice(0, commaIdx).trim();
711 const rest = name.slice(commaIdx + 1).trim();
712 const firstName = rest.split(/\s+/)[0] || '';
713 return (firstName + ' ' + lastName).trim();
714}

748function advanceDueDate(sheet, rowNum, col, currentDueDate, premiumMode){
749 const newDate = new Date(currentDueDate.getTime());
750 const mode = (premiumMode || '').trim();
751 
752 if (mode === 'Monthly') newDate.setMonth(newDate.getMonth() + 1);
753 else if (mode === 'Quarterly') newDate.setMonth(newDate.getMonth() + 3);
754 else if (mode === 'Half-Yearly') newDate.setMonth(newDate.getMonth() + 6);
755 else if (mode === 'Yearly') newDate.setFullYear(newDate.getFullYear() + 1);
756 else return;
757 
758 sheet.getRange(rowNum, col('Due Date') + 1).setValue(newDate);
759}

799function getBirthdaysTodayRows(){
800 const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getSheetByName(BIRTHDAY_SHEET_NAME);
801 if (!sheet) return [];
802 const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
803 const headers = data[0];
804 const col = name => headers.indexOf(name);
805 const tz = Session.getScriptTimeZone();
806 const today = new Date();
807 const todayMonth = today.getMonth(), todayDay = today.getDate();
808 
809 const result = [];

811 const row = data[i];

815 result.push({
816 fullName: row[col('Full Name')],
817 email: row[col('Email')],
818 location: row[col('Location')],
819 dobFormatted: Utilities.formatDate(dob, tz, 'MMMM d'),
820 lastGreetingSent: row[col('Last Greeting Sent (Year)')] || ''
821 });
822 }
823 }
824 return result;
825}

827function countBirthdaysOnOffset(offsetDays){
828 const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getSheetByName(BIRTHDAY_SHEET_NAME);
829 if (!sheet) return 0;
830 const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
831 const headers = data[0];
832 const col = name => headers.indexOf(name);
833 const target = new Date();
834 target.setDate(target.getDate() + offsetDays);
835 const targetMonth = target.getMonth(), targetDay = target.getDate();
836 
837 let count = 0;
838 for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++){
839 const dob = data[i][col('Date of Birth')];
840 if (!(dob instanceof Date)) continue;
841 if (dob.getMonth() === targetMonth && dob.getDate() === targetDay) count++;
842 }
843 return count;
844}

855function sendDailyBirthdayGreetings(){
856 if (!getBirthdayAutoSendStatus().enabled) return;
857 const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet().getSheetByName(BIRTHDAY_SHEET_NAME);
858 if (!sheet) return;
859 const data = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();

861 const col = name => headers.indexOf(name);
862 
863 const today = new Date();
864 const todayMonth = today.getMonth(), todayDay = today.getDate();
865 const currentYearStr = String(today.getFullYear());
866 
867 for (let i = 1; i < data.length; i++){
868 const row = data[i];
869 const sendBday = row[col('Send Birthday?')];
870
871 // SKIP if Send Birthday? is FALSE
872 if (sendBday === false || sendBday === 'FALSE' || sendBday === 0 || sendBday === '0') continue;
873
874 const dob = row[col('Date of Birth')];
875 if (!(dob instanceof Date)) continue;
876 if (dob.getMonth() !== todayMonth || dob.getDate() !== todayDay) continue;
877 
878 const lastSentYear = String(row[col('Last Greeting Sent (Year)')] || '');
879 if (lastSentYear === currentYearStr) continue;
880 
881 let sent = false;
882 try{
883 sent = sendBirthdayEmail(row, col);
884 }catch(err){
885 bumpDailyStat('BDAY_STAT_FAILED');
886 continue;
887 }
888 if (sent){
889 bumpDailyStat('BDAY_STAT_SENT');
890 sheet.getRange(i + 1, col('Last Greeting Sent (Year)') + 1).setValue(currentYearStr);
891 }
892 }
893}

04

Setup Sheet, Run and Authorizing Access

Before deploying, run one one-time setup function from right inside the editor. This also triggers the only permissions prompt you'll need.

  1. In the toolbar at the top of the Apps Script editor, find the function dropdown (it sits next to the Debug button)
  2. Select setupSheet from the list
Apps Script — Function dropdown
  1. Click ▶ Run
  2. A box appears: "Authorization required" — click Review permissions
  3. Choose your Google account
  4. Click Allow
You'll see a screen that says "Google hasn't verified this app." This is expected for a personal script — it isn't an error. Click Advanced, then Go to [project name] (unsafe), then Allow.
Once it finishes, you'll see "Execution completed" at the bottom of the editor. That confirms access is approved — you won't be asked again.
05

Deploy

1–2 Click the blue Deploy button, top right of the Apps Script editor, then click New deployment.
Apps Script — Deploy menu
3 Click the small gear icon ⚙️ next to "Select type" and choose Web app.
New deployment — Select type
4–5 Rename the description to CLIENT PULSE, set Who has access to Anyone, then click Deploy.
New deployment — Configuration
06

Open Client Pulse & finish setup

Your Apps Script backend is deployed. Now connect it to the Client Pulse app and personalize your client emails.

Open Client Pulse
jccbusinesssolutions.github.io/JCCDUESREMINDER
1 Log in using your personal Gmail.
Client Pulse — Sign in
2 Go to Settings and start setting up the app.
3 Copy your Apps Script Web App URL into Setup.
  1. Go back to your Apps Script tab
  2. Click Deploy → Manage deployments
  3. Copy the Web app URL
Apps Script — Web app URL
  1. Paste it into the Connection Setup field in Client Pulse
Client Pulse — Connection Setup
4 Back in Client Pulse, fill in the rest of your branding — name, sender display name, contact email, header and footer photos, and your links.
Header template
canva.link/xn4z7gm3pyu9u2g
Footer template
canva.link/wdi0y4sqkeh5400
Open these in Canva and make a copy. You can change the design however you like — colors, photos, wording — just don't change the size of the template, so your header and footer always fit the email correctly.
Client Pulse — Your Branding
5 Click Save Branding.
07

Upload your data

This is where you bring in your client lists — the Life Policy List powers dues reminders, and the All Client List powers birthday greetings.

Dues Client Dues — Life Policy List
  1. Go to AHO. Under the All Clients tab, download the "Life Policy List" report
  2. Set up your document password and save it
  3. Make sure you're on the Client Dues dashboard, then upload the Life Policy List into the upload box
  4. Click Parse & Push to Sheet
Client Pulse — Client Dues
Bday Client Birthday Greetings — All Client List
  1. Go to AHO. Under the All Clients tab, download the "All Client List" report
  2. Make sure you're on the Client Birthday Greetings dashboard, then upload the All Client List into the upload box
  3. Click Parse & Push to Sheet
Client Pulse — Client Birthday Greetings
08

Set your send time — you're all set

1 Choose the hour window when daily dues reminders and birthday greetings go out.
Client Pulse — Send Time
The send time isn't exact — emails fire sometime within that hour window, not at the minute it starts. Check your Gmail after the window closes to confirm everything went out, and always double-check that the right emails are attached to the right clients.
2 Keep your lists current.
Re-upload and parse your Life Policy List and All Client List at the start of every month — this makes sure any new clients are picked up and included going forward.
Setup complete

You're all set, advisor.

  • ✓ Your Apps Script backend is deployed and connected to Client Pulse
  • ✓ Your branding is saved — name, contact email, photos, and links
  • ✓ Your dues and birthday lists are uploaded and your send time is set

What's next

  • ✓ Daily reminders and birthday greetings send automatically within your chosen window
  • ✓ Check your Dashboard anytime for daily stats
  • ✓ Re-upload at the start of each month to catch new clients

If something doesn't go to plan

A few things that look like errors but are completely normal.

Refresh the sheet tab (F5 or Cmd/Ctrl+R) and wait about 10 seconds. The menu loads after the page finishes opening — it won't appear instantly.
That's expected the first time you run any function. Click through each prompt and choose Allow — it only asks once per permission type.
Normal for a personal script that hasn't gone through Google's public app review — it isn't a security warning about your data. Click Advanced, then Go to [project name] (unsafe), then Allow.
Email jccbusinesssolutions16@gmail.com with a screenshot of what you're seeing and which step you're on.
